title.zh: OpenCode旧系统遭入侵，部分用户API密钥泄露
title.en: OpenCode legacy system breached, exposing some users' API keys

current_state.zh: Hackers breached part of OpenCode's online platform, stole users' API keys, and used them to run up charges on victims' AI accounts.
current_state.en: Hackers breached part of OpenCode's online platform, stole users' API keys, and used them to run up charges on victims' AI accounts.

updates.title_zh: OpenCode遭入侵，OpenAI出手补账：攻击消耗的API额度退还用户

updates.what_changed_zh: OpenCode's legacy system was breached, potentially exposing third-party model API keys for 1.4% of Console users; OpenAI is helping restore service, refunding API credits consumed during the attack, and granting Daybreak Blue defense access.
